name: mochi-maker-workspace
description: Mochi Maker: an agent-first editor that exports models for Live2D Cubism-compatible apps

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/geometry packages/core packages/art packages/export packages/api packages/bridge packages/mcp packages/cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/geometry packages/core packages/art packages/export packages/api packages/bridge packages/mcp packages/cli && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/editor && tsc -p packages/desktop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run format:check
